input.title: Unrecognised card purchase
input.request: I want H&V to investigate a posted card purchase at Fern & Finch Books for £38.40 on 14 July 2025, which I do not recognise, and tell me how I can safely protect my card.

events.text: I show a posted card purchase at Fern & Finch Books for £38.40 on 14 July 2025. Its appearance in your transaction list does not establish who made it.

After completing your identification checks, I’m calling to report that I don’t recognise the Fern & Finch Books purchase. Please raise it with the card team and tell me how to protect my card safely.

summary: Mara Ellery, verified on a call, said she doesn't recognise a £38.40 Fern & Finch Books card purchase from 14 July 2025. She asked for it to be raised with the card team and for advice on protecting her card. The desk registered a request to the card team about the card payment and closed the case as requested. Its attempt to look the purchase up in the card system was refused, so the transaction was not checked against her card records, and the record shows no advice on protecting her card was given, so that is still outstanding.
